name: Sloop
author: Cyberdelia
help: A wrecking ball swings on its chain round a crane, and blocks fly in from all sides to cross its ring on the beat of your music. Turn the wheel to swing the ball: it keeps going and slows down. Be at a block when it lands: the faster the ball, the harder it hits, and a red block hit on its beat takes triple damage. Play gives a hard shove, Prev and Next nudge the ball to aim. A block that reaches the crane costs one of three hearts. A round lasts a track; without music, or when no beat is found, the game keeps its own tempo.

options.name: steering
options.title: Steering
options.help: Swing: turning the wheel pushes the ball round, and it keeps going. Thumb: the ball is pulled toward where your thumb rests on the wheel.

options.name: window
options.title: Downbeat window
options.help: How close to its beat a red block must be hit for triple damage: 80, 120 or 180 ms either side.

options.name: beat
options.title: Play to the music
options.help: On: the game listens to your music and the blocks land on its beat, a round a track. Off: it keeps its own tempo, a little faster each round.

options.name: shake
options.title: Screen shake
options.help: The screen shakes on a heavy smash and when a block reaches the crane.

achievements.name: triple
achievements.title: On the One
achievements.text: Smash a red block on its beat for triple damage.

achievements.name: gold
achievements.title: Gold Rush
achievements.text: Smash five gold blocks in one game.

achievements.name: clean
achievements.title: Clean Round
achievements.text: Clear a round without losing a heart.
